record.title: Dehiba–Wazen development and employment protest closure, April–May 2017
record.scope: Named crossing and documented approach obstruction; no whole-country closure or outline inferred.
record.movement: Ordinary crossing access through the blocked road and locked gates
record.exceptions: Exemptions are not established by the inspected reports.
record.enforcement: Contemporary reports distinguish deliberate road obstruction from checkpoint restrictions and retain the stated traffic scope.
record.relationship: No matching Dehiba April–May 2017 episode in the frozen screen. Existing FU-COV-NAF-001 concerns Ras Jedir, a distinct crossing; R13 Dehiba candidates concern later episodes.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no present border status inferred.
record.current_corrections: Contemporary and retrospective reports date the road-and-gate protest closure to 24 April and the governor’s reported actual restoration to the evening of 8 May 2017: fourteen calendar days.
record.rationale_coding_status: Source-attributed coding accepted after separate challenge; qualifications retained

current_review.adjudication: Accept four new parents/five phases and thirteen native targeted corrections. Keep December/January Ras Jedir campaign phases separate without continuous duration; keep late-2017 Dehiba onset/endpoint unknown and held. Accept explicit 17–18 September NA008 bounds and August22 passenger-blockade onset, retaining conflicting shorthand and freight exclusions. Accept three temporal-display consistency changes with all new coordinates still unlocated. Nine fresh challenge receipts are additional retrieval histories, not independent reporting origins.

access_history.inspected: The report explicitly dates protest closure to Monday 24 April. Following the 8 May evening agreement, the governor said the crossing had returned to its previous activity. Protesters had obstructed the road and locked gates over development and employment demands.
access_history.limitation: One publisher’s retrospective endpoint report, supported by its contemporary continuation report; no separate independent witness, exact clocks, or exhaustive cohort detail.
